- Payload for every case: state {"narration","thing","command","declared"} from the case, questions {"condition_consistent": storygame.runtime.opening_check.OPENING_QUESTION} (import it; never copy the text). Rows carry variant "D".

PASS when forbidden-rejected >= 90% of gated forbidden cases AND clean-accepted >= 90% of gated clean cases AND the run is complete; a partial run is INCONCLUSIVE; else FAIL. Report lines: overall verdict; per set (drain, opening, heldout) counts of forbidden rejected / forbidden total and clean accepted / clean total and uncertain; a separate line for the 11 relabelled cases drain-row-030, drain-row-038, drain-row-051, drain-row-054, drain-row-056, drain-row-061, drain-row-070, drain-row-080, drain-row-081, drain-row-089, drain-row-090 (ids in the file are prefixed 'drain-', e.g. 'drain-drain-row-030' or similar: match by suffix, and print how many are accepted / uncertain / rejected); per-thing lines for the opening set; and lists of every false accept and false reject with case id, thing, median score and the first 200 characters of its narration. 'heldout' is reported but never gated. Exit 0 on PASS, 1 otherwise.
